_comment: Blocks a player may right-click inside someone else's claim, subject to the 'claimInteraction' policy. Shipped with the waystone blocks because FTB Chunks means to whitelist them and misses: it asks for #waystones:waystone and #waystones:sharestone, singular, while Waystones ships them plural. Both its entries are 'required: false', so they resolve to nothing without a warning. Extend this tag from a datapack to cover more blocks.
